mapper.update:
update ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base
seckill_name = #{param.seckillName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
seckill_create_time = #{param.seckillCreateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
seckill_start_time = #{param.seckillStartTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
seckill_end_time = #{param.seckillEndTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
user_id = #{param.userId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
shop_id = #{param.shopId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
user_nick_name = #{param.userNickName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
shop_name = #{param.shopName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
seckill_state = #{param.seckillState,jdbcType=INTEGER},
seckill_hour = #{param.seckillHour,jdbcType=INTEGER},
seckill_start_date = #{param.seckillStartDate},
cancel_time = #{param.cancelTime},
where seckill_id = #{param.seckillId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: SELECT seckill_id AS activityId, seckill_name AS activityName, DATE_FORMAT( seckill_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S' ) AS endTime, '正常' AS stateLabel FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base WHERE seckill_id = #{seckillId}

SELECT a.seckill_goods_id, a.common_id, a.goods_name, a.goods_price, a.seckill_price, a.goods_id, a.goods_start_time AS startDateTime, a.goods_end_time AS endDateTime, a.shop_id, a.goods_image, a.seckill_id, a.goods_upper_limit, a.seckill_num, b.common_name, c.goods_spec, b.common_is_xian, gs.goods_stock FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods a LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common b ON a.common_id = b.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base c ON a.goods_id = c.goods_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_stock gs on c.goods_id = gs.goods_id WHERE a.seckill_id =#{param.seckillId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select seckill_id, seckill_name, seckill_start_time, seckill_end_time, user_id, shop_id, user_nick_name, shop_name, seckill_state, seckill_hour from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base where seckill_id = #{seckillId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

SELECT a.seckill_id as activityId, a.seckill_name as activityName, b.shop_name as shopName, DATE_FORMAT(a.seckill_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as endTime, '正常' as stateLabel FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base a left join ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_base b on a.shop_id = b.supplier_shop_id WHERE a.seckill_state = 1 and b.supplier_shop_id = #{shopId} order by seckill_create_time desc

SELECT seckill_id, seckill_name, seckill_end_time, seckill_hour, seckill_start_time, cancel_time, seckill_start_date FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base WHERE seckill_id = #{seckillId}

SELECT goods_id, common_id, shop_id, goods_name, goods_price, seckill_price, goods_image, goods_upper_limit, seckill_num FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods WHERE seckill_id = #{seckillId}
